definitions.explanation: Describes a state where things or people follow proper order and rules. Used for situations, behavior, or environments that are neat, systematic, and well-regulated.

examples.japanese: {秩序正|ちつじょただ}しい{行列|ぎょうれつ}。
{避難|ひなん}は{秩序正|ちつじょただ}しく{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: The evacuation was carried out in an orderly manner.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}の{中|なか}でも{秩序正|ちつじょただ}しい{行動|こうどう}を{取|と}る{日本人|にほんじん}の{姿|すがた}が{世界|せかい}から{注目|ちゅうもく}された。
examples.english: The sight of Japanese people behaving in an orderly fashion even during disasters attracted worldwide attention.

notes:
Composed of {秩序|ちつじょ} (order, discipline) and {正|ただ}しい (correct, proper). Describes behavior, situations, or environments that maintain good order.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秩序正|ちつじょただ}しい{行動|こうどう}: orderly behavior
- {秩序正|ちつじょただ}しい{行列|ぎょうれつ}: an orderly line/queue
- {秩序正|ちつじょただ}しく{並|なら}ぶ: to line up in an orderly fashion
- {秩序正|ちつじょただ}しく{行動|こうどう}する: to act in an orderly manner

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {整然|せいぜん}とした: neat and orderly — focuses on physical arrangement and tidiness
- {規律正|きりつただ}しい: disciplined — emphasizes adherence to rules and regulations
- {礼儀正|れいぎただ}しい: polite / well-mannered — specifically about social etiquette

USAGE:
The adverbial form {秩序正|ちつじょただ}しく is used frequently, as this word often modifies verbs describing collective behavior.
